title: Look Again: How We Check
subtitle: The Garden Welcome Sign
author: Maria Smith
visual_contract: Words and reveal labels appear above recognisable illustrations. The four sign positions use named corner symbols as well as location. Challenge pages do not contain their answers. Optional picture codes alone may be hidden inside scenes and never gate learning.
mission: Rebuild and check the four-picture Garden Welcome Sign so the garden gate can open before the morning visitors arrive.

new_guest.name: Ivo
new_guest.description: A friendly moss-green garden checker with a round magnifying lens and a checkerboard satchel.

pages.alt: Mia, Tavi and Sol wait beside the closed garden gate just after their turning-light adventure.

pages.text:
Last time, Mia, Sol and Tavi fixed the turning-light trail. Its light shone through the Sunrise Arch. The friends followed it and found a closed garden gate.

"Where does the trail lead next?" asked Tavi.
pages.subtext: You can help the friends find out.
pages.alt: The repaired blue-moon and gold-sun trail shines through the Sunrise Arch. Mia, Tavi and Sol follow it to a closed garden gate.

pages.badge: A SIGN FOR THE MORNING VISITORS
pages.text:
A blank welcome sign stood beside the gate. A picture plan showed where its four pictures belonged.

"The gate needs its sign before the visitors come," said Mia. "Let's make it match the plan, then check it."
pages.subtext: Your mission: finish and check the sign before the morning visitors arrive.
pages.alt: A labelled picture plan shows a sunflower at the sun corner, a bee at the moon corner, a watering can at the leaf corner and a boot at the star corner. A second wooden sign has four empty spaces.

pages.text:
A small moss-green friend hurried from the garden. He carried a round magnifying lens and a checkerboard satchel.

"Hello! I'm Ivo. I help check things carefully. Let's look again together."
pages.subtext: Ivo joins Mia, Sol and Tavi to solve the welcome-sign problem.
pages.alt: Ivo, a friendly moss-green garden checker, greets Mia, Tavi and Sol. His round magnifying lens and checkerboard satchel are clearly labelled.

pages.text:
Ivo put the picture plan where everyone could see it. Each space had a symbol in one corner and a picture inside.

"Let's look closely before we answer," said Mia.
pages.subtext: First find the moon symbol. Then look at the picture beside it.
pages.alt: The upright picture plan has four labelled spaces. Sunflower is at the sun corner, bee at the moon corner, watering can at the leaf corner and boot at the star corner.

pages.text:
Look at the picture plan.

Find the space with the MOON in its corner. Which picture is inside that space? Point before you turn the page.
pages.subtext: Use what you can see on the plan.
pages.alt: The full upright plan stays visible. Four separate answer pictures show a sunflower, a bee, a watering can and a boot.

pages.badge: THE BEE IS IN THE MOON CORNER
pages.text:
The BEE is in the space with the MOON.

You looked before you answered. Saying what you saw is called an OBSERVATION. Choosing without looking would be a GUESS.
pages.subtext: Now the team knows what belongs in the moon space. Find the optional picture code.
pages.alt: The bee picture in the moon-marked space is outlined and labelled OBSERVATION: BEE. The optional code LOOKCLOSE is hidden on Ivo's lens case.

pages.text:
Ivo opened his satchel. Inside were four picture cards and one blank wooden sign.

The picture plan stayed standing. The friends could look at it whenever they needed.
pages.subtext: They will copy what they can see, one picture at a time.
pages.alt: A picture plan stands above a blank four-space sign. Four separate, labelled cards show a sunflower, bee, watering can and boot.

pages.badge: TRY IT - BUILD FROM THE PLAN
pages.text:
Choose one card. Find the same picture on the plan. Put the card in the sign space with the same corner symbol.

Use all four cards once. Fill all four spaces.
pages.subtext: Look back at the plan after every move.
pages.alt: The four loose picture cards wait beside a blank sign with sun, moon, leaf and star corner marks. The picture plan remains visible above them.

pages.text:
SUNFLOWER is with SUN. BEE is with MOON. WATERING CAN is with LEAF. BOOT is with STAR.

All four pictures are in the same places as the picture plan.
pages.subtext: The team built a complete sign while the plan was visible. Find the optional picture code.
pages.alt: The built sign matches the picture plan. Every recognisable picture has its name above it and its corner symbol beside it. The optional code SIGNMAKER is hidden on the sign frame.

pages.text:
Ivo closed a leafy curtain over the picture plan and the finished sign. Then he set down another blank sign and another four cards.

"Let's rebuild it from memory," said Tavi.
pages.subtext: The plan is still behind the curtain. They can open it when they are ready to check.
pages.alt: A leafy curtain clearly covers the picture plan and finished sign. Another blank sign and four picture cards wait in front.

pages.text:
Sol placed the pictures one at a time. Ivo kept one card showing each move. Sol's finished try was:

SUNFLOWER at SUN. BOOT at MOON. WATERING CAN at LEAF. BEE at STAR.

Does it MATCH, DOES NOT MATCH, or are you NOT SURE?
pages.subtext: All three are honest choices while the plan is hidden. Turn the page to check.
pages.alt: Sol's visible memory sign shows sunflower at sun, boot at moon, watering can at leaf and bee at star. The picture plan is still covered. Three answer cards say MATCH, DOES NOT MATCH and NOT SURE, so no answer is exposed.

pages.text:
Ivo opened the curtain. Sol's sign did NOT MATCH. BEE and BOOT had swapped places.

The friends kept Sol's sign beside the plan. "This try can help us see what to fix," said Mia.
pages.subtext: A try that does not match can still help. Find the optional picture code.
pages.alt: The uncovered picture plan and Sol's first try stand side by side. The plan has bee at moon and boot at star. Sol's try has boot at moon and bee at star. The optional code KEEPFIRST is hidden on the saved-try stand.

pages.text:
Look at the picture plan, then Sol's first try. Check each symbol space.

Which two pictures are in different places? Point to both.
pages.subtext: Check all four spaces before you turn the page.
pages.alt: The picture plan and Sol's first try remain side by side with all four named pictures visible. No changed picture is circled yet.

pages.text:
BEE and BOOT are in different places. SUNFLOWER and WATERING CAN are in the same places.

The friends looked at every space, not just one.
pages.subtext: COMPARE means looking at two things side by side to find what is the same and what is different. Find the optional picture code.
pages.alt: Bee and boot are circled on Sol's first try. Sunflower and watering can are labelled SAME. The picture plan and Sol's try both remain visible.

pages.text:
While Sol rebuilt the sign, Ivo kept one card for each picture Sol placed. Now he hung the four cards from first to last.

"These cards let us follow exactly what Sol did," said Ivo.
pages.subtext: These four step cards show what Sol did first, next and last.
pages.alt: Four large step cards hang in order. Step 1 shows sunflower to sun. Step 2 shows watering can to leaf. Step 3 shows boot to moon. Step 4 shows bee to star.

pages.badge: TRY IT - FIND THE FIRST CHANGED STEP
pages.text:
Start at STEP 1. For each card, find the same picture on the plan. Did Sol put it beside the same symbol?

Which is the first step that is different?
pages.subtext: Check the cards in order. Do not skip ahead.
pages.alt: The picture plan and all four ordered step cards are visible. None is marked as the answer.

pages.text:
STEP 3 put BOOT beside MOON. But the picture plan shows BEE beside MOON. STEP 4 then put BEE beside STAR.

STEP 3 is where the mix-up began.
pages.subtext: The step cards helped the friends find the first move to fix. Find the optional picture code.
pages.alt: Step 3 is outlined and labelled FIRST CHANGE. It shows boot moving to the moon corner while the picture plan shows bee there. All four step cards remain visible.

pages.badge: 6 - WILL IT FIT SIDE TO SIDE?
pages.text:
After BEE and BOOT were fixed, the sign matched the plan. Now it had to fit between two hooks.

Ivo placed a ribbon from the left side to the right side. "This distance is called WIDTH. Let's see if the sign fits side to side."
pages.subtext: This ribbon checks width. It does not check the pictures or how tall the sign is.
pages.alt: A clearly labelled WIDTH ribbon stretches from the left edge to the right edge of the repaired sign. Two green marks show the space between the gate hooks.

pages.text:
Look at the left and right edges. They reach the two green marks showing the space between the hooks.

Is the sign the right width? Choose FITS or TOO WIDE.
pages.subtext: Use the side-to-side marks to answer.
pages.alt: The sign's left and right edges align with the two green width marks. Separate answer cards say FITS and TOO WIDE.

pages.text:
The sign FITS between the hooks from side to side.

The width ribbon answered one question: "Does the width fit?" It did not check the pictures or how tall the sign is.
pages.subtext: One tool can answer one clear question. Find the optional picture code.
labels: PICTURES: NOT CHECKED BY THIS RIBBON
BOTTOM TO TOP: NOT CHECKED YET
pages.alt: The width edges and green marks are labelled FITS. Separate labels clearly state that this ribbon did not check picture positions or the distance from bottom to top.

pages.text:
Mia, Sol and Tavi covered their finished sign. On the other side of the hedge, Ivo used the same picture plan, his own blank board and his own cards.

He made a sign without seeing theirs.
pages.subtext: First Ivo will finish his sign. Then everyone will compare.
pages.alt: A hedge separates the covered team sign from Ivo's own check board. Ivo can see the original picture plan but cannot see the team's sign.

pages.badge: TRY IT - COMPARE THE TWO CHECKS
pages.text:
Now uncover both signs. Look at each symbol space.

Are all four pictures in the same places? Choose SAME or DIFFERENT.
pages.subtext: Check all four spaces before you answer.
pages.alt: The team's repaired sign and Ivo's separately rebuilt check sign are visible side by side. Each shows sunflower at sun, bee at moon, watering can at leaf and boot at star.

pages.text:
All four pictures are in the same places. Ivo made his own sign without copying, and it matched.

When a new check gives the same result, we say it CONFIRMS the answer.
pages.subtext: A check made without copying is called an independent check. Sol's earlier try still stays with the team. Find the optional picture code.
pages.alt: Four connecting marks pair the same pictures on the team sign and Ivo's check sign. Sol's first try remains on its stand nearby.

pages.text:
"The width fits, so we're done!" said Mia.

Ivo pointed to the bottom and top. "Wait. We checked side to side, but not bottom to top."

What should the team do now: guess, ask everyone to vote, or measure bottom to top?
pages.subtext: A vote tells which choice people prefer. It does not measure the sign.
pages.alt: Mia points to the width card. Ivo points to the unchecked top and bottom edges. Three answer cards show GUESS, VOTE and MEASURE BOTTOM TO TOP.

pages.text:
The team used a second ribbon from the bottom to the top. That distance is called HEIGHT.

The sign reached the two green height marks. Its height fits too.
pages.subtext: Ivo's words alone were not the answer. Measuring gave the team the answer. Sometimes a difference of opinion shows what to check next. Find the optional picture code.
pages.alt: A vertical HEIGHT ribbon runs from the bottom edge to the top edge of the sign. Both edges align with green height marks and are labelled HEIGHT: FITS.

pages.text:
Before opening the gate, the friends stopped for four last questions:

Do the pictures match the plan? Does the sign fit side to side? Does it fit bottom to top? Did Ivo's own sign match?
pages.subtext: They kept one card from each check. A kept card that shows what happened is called a RECORD.
pages.alt: The repaired sign stands beside four large question spaces. Four illustrated cards show the picture-plan comparison, the side-to-side ribbon, the bottom-to-top ribbon and Ivo's own check.

pages.badge: TRY IT - MATCH EACH QUESTION TO A CARD
pages.text:
Four questions. Four check cards. Match each question with the card that shows its answer.

Can you give every question a card?
pages.subtext: Use the cards the friends kept. A nice-looking sign is not enough.
pages.alt: Four named gate questions and four illustrated check cards wait to be matched. No answer mark is filled yet.

pages.badge: EVERY QUESTION HAS A CHECKED ANSWER
pages.text:
The pictures match. The width fits. The height fits. Ivo's own sign matches.

Every question has a checked answer. The gate opened before the visitors arrived!
pages.subtext: Sol's first try stays with the other cards so the friends can remember what they changed. Find the optional picture code.
pages.alt: All four question spaces show a checked answer beside an illustrated card. The garden gate stands open behind the checked sign. Sol's saved first try remains nearby.

pages.text:
You looked at a plan, built a sign and kept Sol's first try. The step cards showed where the mix-up began. One ribbon checked width. Another checked height. Ivo made his own sign without copying.

A check can show that things match, show a difference, or show what to check next.
pages.subtext: Checking helps us explain what we saw, find a change and know what to do next.
pages.alt: Five labelled mini-scenes recap the child's actions: looking at the picture plan, keeping Sol's first try, following the step cards, measuring width and height separately, and watching Ivo make his own check without copying.

pages.text:
The morning visitors followed the checked sign into the garden. Mia, Sol, Tavi and Ivo watched them find the right path.

On the far wall, another Star Door clicked softly. The friends smiled and wondered where it led.
pages.subtext: End of this adventure. The next one is still a mystery.
pages.alt: The checked four-picture sign guides visitors through the open garden gate. Mia, Tavi, Sol and Ivo look towards a closed Star Door at the far garden wall.
